title: Driver paperwork submission / deadline handling - historical 2013 evidence
summary: A restricted 2013 driver/vehicle-safety case contains a separate operational dispute about driver paperwork. It shows that paperwork had a deadline and designated drop point and that faxing had been disallowed for that employee/process. No current authoritative driver-paperwork procedure was located in the existing corpus.

claims.claim: The 2013 case records management concern about receiving required driver paperwork by a deadline and references a designated drop location for submission.

evidence.page_or_section: restricted 2013 driver case - generalized paperwork-routing statements
evidence.note: Employee identity and case facts excluded.

claims.claim: The same historical case states the employee had been told not to fax the paperwork anymore, demonstrating that submission-channel rules could be specifically controlled rather than allowing any available channel.

evidence.page_or_section: restricted 2013 driver case - generalized submission-channel instruction
evidence.note: No current ban on faxing is inferred.

claims.claim: No current driver paperwork/drop-point/fax rule was found in the presently indexed driver training, job-description or handbook sources, so these 2013 details remain historical workflow evidence only.

evidence.note: Current-corpus search did not locate a superseding procedure.

trigger: Driver must submit operational paperwork/manifests/forms to management.
prerequisites: Identify current required form, deadline and approved submission channel.
actors: Human Resources where corrective action is involved
systems: Historical physical drop point / fax channel - exact system unknown
forms: Driver operational paperwork - exact form set unresolved
steps: Submit it through the approved channel/location by the required deadline.
Escalate inability to meet the deadline before it becomes overdue.
Document repeated submission failures under the current coaching/discipline process if warranted.
decisions: Whether the submission channel is approved.
deadlines: Historical source references a deadline but does not provide a reusable universal cutoff.
controls: Do not treat fax prohibition from one historical case as current universal policy.
Use a validated current channel/deadline before automating enforcement.
unresolved_questions: What driver paperwork/forms are currently required daily/weekly, who receives them, and what are the deadlines?
What submission channels are currently approved (paper drop, scan, email, system upload, mobile app)?
Which paperwork can be submitted electronically and what original-retention requirements apply?
automation_candidates: Driver paperwork intake checklist with required-document, deadline and channel validation.
Missing/late paperwork queue that alerts the responsible supervisor before deadline failure.
Replace informal drop/fax instructions with a versioned, role-specific submission SOP.

provenance.notes: No employee identity or case allegation stored.
